title: GEEKS RULE Presses Aiobahn's Viral “DIVA” Artwork Into a Hatsune Miku Triple-Collab T-Shirt
summary:
Summary

GEEKS RULE has teamed with Hatsune Miku and producer Aiobahn on a three-way collaboration T-shirtThe design centers on the cover artwork of Aiobahn's Vocaloid track “DIVA” (feat. Hatsune Miku), reproduced through GEEKS RULE's silkscreen printingAiobahn will appear as a DJ at GR8 on release day, with the tee also sold online by lottery

GEEKS RULE has brought together Hatsune Miku and producer Aiobahn for a triple-collaboration T-shirt built around one of the Vocaloid world's recent standout moments. The tee draws its graphic from the cover artwork of Aiobahn's “DIVA” (feat. Hatsune Miku), translating the track's visual identity into apparel through the label's silkscreen printing.To understand why this shirt exists, it helps to understand the pull of its three names. Hatsune Miku, the Crypton Future Media virtual singer launched in 2007, has spent nearly two decades as the face of Vocaloid culture, a software voice that grew into a genuine pop icon with a catalog powered by an entire community of producers. Aiobahn, a producer known within electronic and Vocaloid circles, sits squarely in that lineage, and his “DIVA” (feat. Hatsune Miku) became a talking point across both the Vocaloid scene and wider electronic-music listeners.That song's cover art is the centerpiece here. Rather than lean on a generic Miku likeness, the collaboration zeroes in on the DIVA jacket artwork, the image already tied to the track in fans' minds, and makes it the hero of the garment. GEEKS RULE leans on the precision silkscreen printing the label is known for to carry the artwork over, aiming to preserve the emotional, edgy atmosphere of the original rather than flatten it into a simple graphic tee.The release also doubles as an event, which fits GEEKS RULE's role as a hub for music-adjacent streetwear. On the August 29 drop date, Aiobahn himself will step behind the decks as a DJ inside GR8, turning the launch into a party rather than a quiet stock update. It is the kind of artist-present moment that ties the garment back to the music it celebrates.The GEEKS RULE x Hatsune Miku x Aiobahn T-shirt releases August 29, sold at GR8 and through the GEEKS RULE online store by lottery.

title: SKIMS Enlists Supreme Veteran & Lemaire Designer Duo Exits Uniqlo U in This Week's Top Fashion News
summary:
SummarySKIMS names a Supreme veteran as design chief, Authentic Brands Group acquires a majority stake in Drake’s OVO, and Uniqlo U says farewell to Christophe Lemaire and Sarah-Linh Tran.UGG debuts a capsule with Willy Chavarria, while Gunna leads Under Armour’s new P-Star collection.Gucci taps global stars, like BTS's Jin, EsDeeKid, Rico Nasty, and Shawn Mendes, for its Primavera push.SKIMS' New Chief Design Officer Spent 22 Years at SupremeKim Kardashian’s SKIMS shifted its creative strategy this week, appointing Erin Magee as the brand’s first-ever Chief Design Officer. The move followed Magee’s recent departure from legendary streetwear label Supreme, where she spent 22 years shaping its cultural dominance and visual identity. Magee, who also founded the women’s streetwear brand Mademe, takes on the responsibility of guiding SKIMS’ creative product direction as it expands its global footprint. Kardashian praised Magee’s ability to connect with audiences and push creative boundaries. Alongside Magee's appointment, SKIMS also promoted Kim Schraub to the newly minted role of Chief Brand Officer, signaling a robust structural shift for the booming shapewear empire.Christophe Lemaire & Sarah-Linh Tran Exit Uniqlo UAfter a defining 10-year run, Christophe Lemaire and Sarah-Linh Tran stepped down as the inaugural head designers of Uniqlo U. Their FW26 collection served as their final release for the Japanese retailer's design-forward sub-label. Since 2015, the duo bridged the gap between functional basics and high-end minimalism, transforming Uniqlo U into a commercial powerhouse that generated an estimated $1 billion in 2025 alone, according to Binance. While Uniqlo confirmed their departure, the retailer assured fans that the sub-label will continue. The fashion world now watches to see who will take the reins and if the brand can maintain its maison-level appeal without its foundational creative minds.Authentic Brands Group Acquires Majority Stake in Drake's OVO BrandGlobal brand management firm Authentic Brands Group acquired a 51% majority stake in October’s Very Own (OVO), the lifestyle brand co-founded by Drake. Under the new agreement, Drake retained a 44% share of the intellectual property, while Vince Holding Corp. secured the remaining 5% and stepped in as the core global apparel and retail licensee. The Toronto-based OVO team will continue to handle creative and design operations, but Vince Holding is taking over production, merchandising, and back-of-house logistics. The strategic buyout aims to scale OVO's footprint aggressively, with plans to open three new United States retail locations next year before pushing into major wholesale distribution in 2027.UGG and Willy Chavarria Announce Debut Capsule CollectionUGG and designer Willy Chavarria unveiled their debut collaborative capsule, blending Chavarria’s sharp cultural aesthetic with UGG’s signature boots. The unisex collection features five distinct footwear styles, including the Guard Boot, Biker Boot, and Hotel Chavarria Slipper, alongside a co-branded tee and socks. To launch the collection, the duo released the “UGG & KISSES” campaign, starring a heavy-hitting cast that includes Eva Longoria, Danny Trejo, Becky G, and Ivan Cornejo. Inspired by the '90s sitcom Married… with Children, the campaign reimagines familiar television tropes through Chavarria’s Mexican-American lens. The fierce yet friendly lineup drops globally on September 10, 2026.Gucci's Primavera Campaign Is a Fusion of K-Pop, UK Underground, DMV Rap & MoreDemna’s egalitarian vision for Gucci continues with the star-studded FW26 Primavera campaign. Photographed by Michal Chelbin against a rustic Italian interior, the visual push highlights a softer side of the fashion house's everyday wear. Leather and fur dominate the styling, with standout pieces like Jin’s motorsport jacket and Alex Consani’s purple sequined centerpiece dress stealing the show. The diverse international cast leans heavily into global pop culture, featuring BTS’s Jin, Shawn Mendes, Rico Nasty, NINGNING, and UK underground artist EsDeeKid. The campaign also pulls talent from the sports and film worlds, enlisting NFL legend Tom Brady alongside actors Xiao Zhan and Lee Young Ae.Under Armour Names Gunna Global Brand Ambassador and Creative Director of P-StarUnder Armour deepened its ties with hip-hop, officially appointing Grammy-nominated rapper Gunna as Global Brand Ambassador and Creative Director of P-Star. This new community-driven platform encompasses footwear and apparel, pulling design cues from Gunna’s lifestyle of travel, training, and stage performances. The debut 14-piece collection includes heavyweight tees, shorts, and American football-inspired HeatGear, all stamped with the P-Star logo. Additionally, the partnership introduces the UA Scorpio, a futuristic new sneaker utilizing UA HOVR cushioning. The silhouette drops in a hyper-limited "Gunna" colorway on August 27, 2026, ahead of a wider global rollout planned for early 2027.

title: TDR Broadens FW26 Collection With Technical Fabrics and Expert Craftsmanship
summary:
West London retailer The Garbstore has unveiled the Fall/Winter 2026 collection for its in-house label, TDR. The brainchild of founder Ian Paley, the new seasonal range expands the brand's offerings across both menswear and womenswear, drawing inspiration from decades of expertise in archived utility garments and global textile sourcing.Focusing on subtle, muted tones and intricate construction details, the latest lineup bridges the gap between British heritage and Japanese silhouettes, emphasizing functional durability and tactile quality. Outerwear highlights include the Cordura Balmacaan overcoat, available in unlined or Japanese Primaloft-insulated versions, alongside the Japanese canvas-lined Duxville Jacket with raglan sleeves and wrap-around pouch pockets.Denim and workwear continue to anchor the collection through pieces like the 11oz Hiroshima-woven denim Coverall Removed Jacket, featuring hand-distressed detailing, sun-aged dyeing, and hidden pocketing, alongside the military-inspired Jungle Repair Pant. In knitwear, TDR elevates to new heights to utilize the innovative Shima Seiki 3D knitting technology in Scotland for 100% British lambswool seamless crews, tunics, beanies, and scarves. Elsewhere, it is the Japanese cotton-wool check overshirts and signature crown chinos that complete the versatile drop.The full TDR collection is available now, with rolling releases available online and in-store at Couverture & The Garbstore over the following week.

title: CARNIVAL Brings Harajuku-Based WEEKEND SEQUEL to Bangkok for Exclusive Pop-Up
summary:
Summary

CARNIVAL hosts Tokyo’s WEEKEND SEQUEL for its first Thailand pop-up at CARNIVAL ONE BANGKOK.Features collaborative T-shirts combining CARNIVAL, WEEKEND SEQUEL, and Hiroshi Fujiwara’s fragment design branding.Runs August 29–30, 2026, at CARNIVAL ONE BANGKOK.

Leading Thai streetwear boutique CARNIVAL is bringing Harajuku-based retail concept WEEKEND SEQUEL to Thailand for the very first time through an exclusive two-day pop-up event. Founded by Yasunari Miyazaki, WEEKEND SEQUEL is a Tokyo-based project famous for its distinct rhythm — opening its physical Harajuku doors strictly on weekends to create a fleeting gathering place for product releases, street culture and community. The project is also closely associated with Hiroshi Fujiwara, founder of fragment design, whose creative presence and iconic lightning bolt insignia have become defining elements of the WEEKEND SEQUEL identity.To mark this cross-cultural connection between Tokyo and Bangkok, the collaboration debuts a special event-exclusive T-shirt collection that fuses the visual identities of CARNIVAL, WEEKEND SEQUEL, and fragment design. Designed to introduce the ephemeral, in-person spirit of Harajuku's weekend culture to Southeast Asia, the CARNIVAL x WEEKEND SEQUEL pop-up will run on August 29 - 30, 2026. The experience and limited graphic tees will be hosted at the CARNIVAL ONE BANGKOK flagship store, located in The Storeys at One Bangkok.

title: Diesel and ‘Final Fantasy XIV’ Channel a “Brave” Spirit for Their Collaborative Capsule
summary:
Summary

Diesel teams up with Final Fantasy XIV on a 27-piece "BRAVE" capsule collection.The range features graphic hoodies, character tees, washed denim sets and Mothercrystal jewelry.Launches September 16, 2026, via Tokyo pop-ups and Diesel online.

Diesel has teamed up with Square Enix's acclaimed MMORPG Final Fantasy XIV for a multi-faceted project anchored in the shared philosophy of "BRAVE".Fusing fashion, gaming culture and contemporary art, the centerpiece of the project is a 27-piece capsule collection. The lineup translates rich gaming lore into streetwear staples, spanning washed denim jackets, wide-leg denim trousers, hoodies, long-sleeve tees, graphic T-shirts and silver jewelry. Design motifs draw directly from the world of Hydaelyn, featuring imagery of Azem’s Crystal, the Mothercrystal, the Grand Companies of Eorzea and iconic Scions of the Seventh Dawn characters including Y'shtola, Thancred, Alphinaud, and Estinien.Ranging in price from ¥11,000 to ¥207,900 JPY (approx. $69 - $1,302 USD), the collection kicks off on September 16, 2026, with an exclusive pop-up at Isetan Shinjuku in Tokyo, which will offer custom job-icon embroidery services and a 30-set limited "Scions of the Seventh Dawn Complete Box". A wider release follows on October 2, 2026, via Diesel's official online store and the DIESEL SHIBUYA flagship, alongside secondary pop-ups at Hankyu Umeda in Osaka and Iwataya in Fukuoka later in the month. Coinciding with the drop, DIESEL ART GALLERY in Shibuya will host a collaborative collage art exhibition by renowned artist Kosuke Kawamura from October 2 through November 8, 2026.

title: Lee Byung-hun and Squid Game Creator Hwang Dong-hyuk Reunite for Sci-Fi Thriller ‘K.O. Club’
summary:
Summary

Lee Byung-hun is reuniting with Squid Game creator Hwang Dong-hyuk to lead the sci-fi thriller K.O. ClubThe film is Hwang's first feature in nearly ten years and centers on a near-future generational war over the ability to buy biological youthFellow Squid Game alum Park Hae-soo joins an ensemble that also includes Oh Jung-se, Cho Yeo-jeong and Kim So-jin

Lee Byung-hun is reuniting with Squid Game creator Hwang Dong-hyuk, this time on the big screen, to headline the sci-fi thriller K.O. Club. The project marks Hwang's first feature film in nearly a decade, with his production company Firstman Studio, which he runs with producer Kim Ji-yeon, confirming the casting and targeting a filming start in the first half of 2027.Lee is stepping back into Hwang's orbit after playing the Front Man across the Squid Game franchise, and he is not making the jump alone. The lineup also features Park Hae-soo, another face from the Squid Game world, alongside three actors coming into Hwang's fold for the first time: Oh Jung-se of It's Okay to Not Be Okay, Cho Yeo-jeong of Parasite and Kim So-jin of The Man Standing Next.The story trades the deadly playground of Squid Game for a dystopian near-future, but keeps the class conflict that runs through Hwang's work. In K.O. Club, wealth can purchase biological youth, and the film sets an aging elite that hoards money and power against a younger generation shut out of both. The title itself lays the premise bare: K.O. Club is shorthand for "Killing Oldmen Club," a name that names the generational war at the center of the plot.Firstman Studio made its name helping carry Squid Game to a worldwide audience and has since moved into television with the series Affairs Not the Only Secret. K.O. Club now stands as the company's return to feature production, made hand in hand with its founder.For Hwang, the film caps a period of enormous visibility. Squid Game ran for three seasons on Netflix and became one of the platform's most-watched titles anywhere, and it leaves him one of Korean entertainment's most closely tracked names as he pivots back to cinema.K.O. Club is targeting a filming start in the first half of 2027. Stay tuned for an official trailer and release date.

title: Globe-Trotter Restores 1-of-1 Vintage Trunks for the Second “Renewed Edit” Drop
summary:
Summary

Globe-Trotter debuts drop two of The Renewed Collection, offering hand-restored 1-of-1 vintage luggage.Handcrafted in Hertfordshire from Vulcanised Fibreboard, featuring original patinas, travel stickers, and leather trims.Available now exclusively online.

British luxury luggage house Globe-Trotter has introduced the second drop of The Renewed Collection, the foundational release under its circular initiative, The Restoration Edit. Following the immediate sell-out of its initial launch, this second release brings forward a newly curated series of one-of-a-kind vintage suitcases, each painstakingly restored by hand at the brand’s Hertfordshire workshop.Handcrafted using Globe-Trotter’s proprietary Vulcanised Fibreboard and reinforced with vegetable-tanned leather, the pieces are renewed using original manufacturing techniques that date back to 1897. Rather than erasing age, the restoration process carefully repairs essential hardware and structural elements while preserving the unique patina, travel stickers and historical character that make each piece a singular living archive.Notable highlights in the new drop include vibrant orange, cream, and sky-blue colorways, featuring contrasting leather straps, custom lining patterns, and original travel decals from historic airlines. Because every restored trunk is entirely unique, each piece exists as a true 1-of-1. The second drop of The Renewed Collection is available exclusively online via yhe brand's website, with Globe-Trotter set to expand the initiative later this year through "The Archive," a forthcoming release of exceptionally rare historic pieces curated directly from the brand’s heritage vaults.

title: Universal Studios Japan Drops Luffy Into ‘Jurassic Park’ for Its 25th Anniversary Merch
summary:
Summary

Universal Studios Japan is marking its 25th anniversary with a goods collection pairing hit anime franchises with the park's signature film attractionsThe lineup crosses 'ONE PIECE' with 'Jurassic Park,' 'Detective Conan' with 'Back to the Future,' and Junji Ito's Tomie with the Halloween icon Street ZombieThe range spans apparel and accessories including T-shirts, tote bags, stainless bottles, figures and mugs

Universal Studios Japan is celebrating its 25th anniversary by mashing up its most popular anime tie-ins with the film franchises that anchor the park, headlined by an ONE PIECE x Jurassic Park crossover and a Detective Conan x Back to the Future pairing. The special goods collection fuses each anime's world with a signature USJ attraction, arriving under the anniversary's "Discover U!!!" banner.The ONE PIECE design plants the Straw Hats' energy squarely inside the park's dinosaur territory. It depicts Luffy deep in the lush foliage of the Jurassic Park area, turkey leg in hand, cutting loose alongside a towering T-Rex. The result leans into the playful contrast between the anime's adventuring spirit and the attraction's dynamic, primeval setting, letting two very different worlds share one frame.The Detective Conan entry takes a more cinematic tack. Conan Edogawa and Professor Agasa appear in a design that directly homages the Back to the Future movie poster, a nod that gains extra resonance because Back to the Future returned to the park as part of the 25th-anniversary event "Universal Cars and Stars Collection." It is a crossover pitched at fans who can read both references at once, the kind of generation and franchise-spanning mashup the milestone year is built to enable.Rounding out the trio is a darker pairing aimed at the park's horror faithful. Junji Ito's celebrated horror manga Tomie is matched with Street Zombie, the emblem of USJ's Halloween Horror Night, bringing a world-renowned name in horror illustration together with the park's signature scare mascot.The merchandise itself spans everyday carry and collector pieces. Across the three collaborations, the range includes T-shirts, tote bags, stainless bottles, figures and mugs, giving fans of each franchise a mix of wearable and displayable options. Both pairings and their designs draw on long park histories: ONE PIECE has been a marquee USJ summer event since 2007, while Detective Conan, celebrating its TV anime's 30th anniversary this year, has appeared at the park since 2017 with attractions like real-escape-game experiences. Adding to the occasion, USJ says it has received congratulatory messages from original creators Eiichiro Oda and Gosho Aoyama marking the anniversary.The Universal Studios Japan 25th-anniversary collaboration goods go on sale September 9 at Studio Style.

title: Maison Margiela REPLICA’s “Lost Eden” Scent Builds a Forbidden Fruit Accord From Candied Apple, Vanilla and Smoky Oud
summary:
Summary

Maison Margiela REPLICA’s Lost Eden is a fruity-woody Eau de Parfum structured around a Forbidden Fruit AccordThe composition runs from a candied red apple top through a vanilla heart to a smoky oud baseThe scent ships in a weighted, black-lacquered Fantasies bottle in both a full 100ml size and a travel-friendly 10ml

Maison Margiela REPLICA has added “Lost Eden" to its Eau de Parfum lineup, a fruity-woody fragrance constructed around the collection's Forbidden Fruit Accord. Rather than chase a single dominant note, the scent is built as a three-part progression, moving from a liquor-like candied apple opening into a gourmand vanilla center and closing on a dark, smoky wood.The composition leads with a Candied Red Apple Accord, a juicy, almost liqueur-soaked top note that Margiela frames as the fragrance's first hit of temptation. The apple carries the opening's brightness and its slightly sweet, tart edge, setting up the Eden theme the scent is named for before the heavier materials arrive.Underneath sits a Vanilla Infusion at the heart. Positioned as the addictive, sultry middle of the pyramid, the vanilla softens the fruit and adds the gourmand warmth that keeps the composition from reading as a straight fruity scent. It functions as the bridge between the sweetness up top and the smoke below.The base is where the fragrance turns woody. A Smoky Oud Accord grounds everything with a long-lasting, smoky-woody depth, the note responsible for the fragrance's darker, more shadowed finish and its staying power on skin. Together the three accords give Lost Eden its intended contrast: gourmand sweetness pulled against an enigmatic, woody trail.The packaging is treated as part of the concept. Lost Eden belongs to the REPLICA Fantasies grouping, and its flacon wears a graduated black lacquer meant to evoke nightfall and the collection's dreamlike, imagined worlds. Fashioned in weighted glass and sealed at the neck with a deep black rope, the bottle carries the house's signature label with the brand logo rendered in a new textured silver finish, its iridescence shifting with the light. The Eau de Parfum comes in a standard 100ml/3.4 fl oz bottle and a travel-friendly 10ml/0.34 fl oz size.Maison Margiela REPLICA Lost Eden Eau de Parfum is available in 100ml and 10ml sizes via Maison Margiela Fragrances.

title: Hobonichi Techo and POTR’s "Stride" Cover Carries Your Planner and Essentials Like a Bag
summary:
Summary

The Hobonichi Techo's 2027 "Stride" cover is a collaboration with POTR, the lifestyle label rooted in Yoshida & Co.'s bag-making craftBuilt from matte, soft-touch nylon, the cover is shaped like a small bag with a removable shoulder strap so the techo can be carried hands-freeIt launches in two versions, a peacock blue A6 Original and an evergreen A5 Cousin, each with a full system of interior and exterior pockets

Hobonichi Techo has revealed "Stride," a new cover for 2027 made in collaboration with POTR, a lifestyle brand drawing on the artisanship of Yoshida & Co. Rather than treating the cover as a simple sleeve, the two have reimagined it as a compact carry piece, wrapping the planner in bonding-treated nylon and adding a removable strap so the whole thing can be slung over a shoulder like a bag.The material sets the tone. Each cover is cut from a supple nylon finished with Yoshida & Co.'s signature bonding treatment, giving it a matte surface that stays soft to the touch. That fabric expertise is the throughline of the partnership: POTR operates as a lifestyle offshoot of Yoshida & Co., the Japanese manufacturer behind the long-running PORTER label, and the "Stride" cover leans on that heritage of everyday carry goods rather than treating the techo as pure stationery.Function is where the bag concept earns its name. A front flap pocket keeps small items like earphones within reach, while a back pocket closes with a one-touch snap fastener sized for the things you grab most often. Unzip the cover and the interior opens into a considered storage layout: three card pockets and a clear pocket on the left, a zippered mesh pocket on the right, and a pen hook that takes slim pens directly or clips thicker ones. The included black shoulder strap detaches and adjusts to length, so the cover can travel closed and hands-free.The two sizes are tuned to different planners and different palettes. The A6 Original arrives in peacock blue, a refined shade meant to read as a stylish accent against any outfit, with an interior lined in navy and light gray and a single-compartment front flap pocket. The larger A5 Cousin comes in evergreen, a deep, composed green that settles easily into a workday or a day off, paired with a green-and-beige interior and a front flap divided into two sections for tidier organization. The Cousin's back pocket also runs roomier, with space for a smartphone alongside documents. A circular logo stitched to the front finishes both.Taken together, the two covers make a clear pitch to the Hobonichi faithful, a community that treats the techo less as an agenda and more as a daily companion. By building the cover to leave the house on its own, POTR and Hobonichi Techo are nudging the planner further into everyday-carry territory, somewhere between a notebook and the small bag you already reach for on the way out the door.Both "Stride" covers go on sale September 1 at 11 a.m. Japan time through the Hobonichi Techo online store.

title: New Era and Brooks Brothers Stitch the Golden Fleece Onto Buckram-Free 59FIFTY and Cross-Strap 9TWENTY Caps
summary:
Summary

New Era and Brooks Brothers have teamed on a co-branded cap collection carrying the Brooks Brothers logo and its Golden Fleece emblemThe lineup runs across two silhouettes, a structured-but-soft 59FIFTY fitted and an adjustable cross-strap 9TWENTYSix colorways span denim washes on the fitted and muted pastels on the adjustable

New Era and Brooks Brothers have joined forces on a third headwear collection that puts the American trad house's branding on two of New Era's core silhouettes. Built around the Brooks Brothers logo and its Golden Fleece emblem, the capsule is split between a 59FIFTY fitted cap and an adjustable 9TWENTY, each engineered for a softer wear than their standard counterparts.The 59FIFTY is the more construction-focused of the two. New Era has removed the inner buckram from the front panel, dropping the stiff structure that normally holds a fitted cap upright in favor of a softer, more relaxed feel against the head. Because it carries no adjuster, the fit is dialed in through sizing rather than a strap, offered in roughly 1cm increments so wearers across a wide range of head sizes can land a precise fit. The absence of a rear closure also leaves the back panel clean, giving the cap an unbroken silhouette. This version is cut from denim, with a cotton composition, and comes in two washes: Indigo Denim and Washed Denim.The 9TWENTY handles the adjustable side of the range. It uses an unstructured, coreless front for the same soft feel up top, then adds a rear cross-strap for on-the-fly sizing. Rather than a single one-size build, New Era offers it in three spans, S/M (54–58cm), M/L (57–61cm) and L/XL (61–65cm), so the strap fine-tunes an already close base size. The 9TWENTY is cotton and arrives in four muted tones: Camel, Blue Tint, Blush Sky and Lavender.Branding is the connective tissue across both silhouettes. Each cap carries the Brooks Brothers logo alongside the Golden Fleece, the house's longstanding emblem, positioning the graphics as the throughline that ties the denim fitted and the pastel adjustable into one collection. The result is a headwear range that leans on material and fit distinctions up front while using shared insignia to hold the capsule together.The New Era x Brooks Brothers cap collection is available through New Era Japan.

title: Authentic Brands Group Acquires Majority Stake in Drake's OVO Brand
summary:
Summary

Authentic Brands Group has acquired a 51% majority stake in Drake’s lifestyle brand OVOCo-founder Drake retains a 44% stake while Vince Holding Corp takes a 5 percent share and global licensing rightsThe strategic partnership plans to expand OVO's U S retail footprint and launch wholesale distribution in 2027

Authentic Brands Group has officially acquired a 51% majority stake in the intellectual property of October’s Very Own (OVO). The deal partners the global brand management platform with co-founder Drake, while tapping Vince Holding Corp. as OVO's core global apparel and retail licensee.Under the terms of the transaction, Drake retains a 44% ownership stake in the brand, while Vince Holding Corp. acquires 5% alongside the operational rights to OVO’s retail footprint. Founded in 2008 by Aubrey "Drake" Graham, Oliver El-Khatib, and Noah "40" Shebib, the Toronto-bred label currently operates 12 standalone stores across Canada, the United States, and the United Kingdom. Under the new agreement, OVO’s creative and design teams will remain based in Toronto, while Vince Holding oversees global production, merchandising, logistics, and back-of-house operations.The transaction aims to accelerate OVO’s expansion within the global streetwear market. Vince Holding plans to open three new U.S. retail locations next year before introducing OVO into major wholesale accounts starting in 2027.

title: What Is Uniqlo U Without the Lemaire Duo?
summary:
This week’s unveiling of the latest Uniqlo U range not only marks the 10th anniversary of Christophe Lemaire and Sarah-Linh Tran’s line, but also their final release as its head designers. After months of speculation, Uniqlo’s messaging around the FW26 collection has explicitly confirmed the conclusion of their direction over Uniqlo U. However, the brand also stated that “their meticulous tailoring and timeless designs will continue to live on in the next chapter of Uniqlo U,” signaling that the line has not reached the end of its life.For the last 10 years, Uniqlo U has served as the Japanese retailer’s more elevated, design-forward range, coexisting with its established main line. Binance reported that in 2025, Uniqlo U may have contributed an estimated $1 billion in annual retail sales, amounting to 5% of Uniqlo’s revenue for the fiscal year. Uniqlo U’s consistent popularity was only amplified by the accelerating growth of Lemaire. According to BoF, Lemaire’s sales grew from €10 million in 2019 to over €103 million in 2024. The relationship was mutually beneficial.In short, it was the right partnership at the right time. During the 2010s, fashion-conscious consumers began to take greater notice of quality and developed a taste for more considered minimalism amid rapid microtrends. It was the era when the “normcore” aesthetic emerged and “athleisure” evolved into a distinct category in the fashion landscape. In tandem with Uniqlo’s pared-back basics, Uniqlo U offered a meeting in the middle: a versatile balance of function and style, consistent newness executed with a timeless sensibility, and designer-approved pieces at accessible price points.But the Lemaire-powered U label wasn’t the first or only collaboration the retailer has had. The company had been perfecting its formula in the years leading up to Uniqlo U. Notably, it seemed to understand the movement toward minimalism with preceding collaborations: Jil Sander (2009), Undercover (2012), Theory (2014), and more. Shortly after a limited-edition Lemaire x Uniqlo collection in 2015, Christophe Lemaire and Sarah-Linh Tran were appointed the inaugural designers of the Uniqlo U line and the artistic directors of the company’s R&D (research and development) lab in Paris.Since then, the retailer has expanded its scope, maintaining ongoing collaborative lines with designer Jonathan Anderson, tennis player Roger Federer, and artist KAWS. Furthermore, in 2024, the company appointed Clare Waight Keller as global creative director and introduced her dedicated Uniqlo: C line. By 2025, Fast Retailing saw its Japanese revenue surpass 1 trillion yen, a first-ever for the company. While much of this can be attributed to global retail expansion, the label is also increasingly defined by its longstanding collaborators, so it's worth asking whether their departures could affect its success. With the brand saying farewell to the duo that has propped up its longest-running collaboration, what’s next for Uniqlo U?The news leaves open questions about whether the company will appoint a new designer for the U line or if it can continue successfully without a collaborative leader. The retailer has invested deeply in relationships with some of the most respected designers, and it’s the Lemaire duo who have done much of the heavy lifting for the brand over the last decade. Uniqlo stands out as a mass brand with maison-level designer affiliations, and if we can learn anything from the major fashion houses, it's that the DNA of the best creative directors remains long after their leadership concludes.

title: PHENIX's "Where's the Goddamn Horizon?" Collection Reengineers Alpine Tailoring for FW26
summary:
Summary

PHENIX unveils a Fall/Winter 2026 collection themed around the disappearance and redefinition of the horizon lineThe design language draws on film director David Lynch and a disoriented pilot's cry mid-dogfight to warp length balance, cutting, and structural seamsTechnical mountain fabrics meet urban minimalism as the label carries its 70-plus years of ski expertise into a fashion-focused line

PHENIX has unveiled its Fall/Winter 2026 collection, a lineup that takes the horizon itself as its central subject and then deliberately loses it. Presented under the label's ongoing "From Snow Mountain to the Streets" concept, the season is titled "Where's the Goddamn Horizon?" and treats the vanishing of a stable baseline as both a mood and a construction method.The theme reaches back to two reference points named in the collection's framing. One is the fascination with the aesthetics of the horizon that director David Lynch developed in his younger years. The other is the phrase shouted in the chaos of aerial combat that gives the season its name, the moment a pilot caught in a dogfight loses all sense of orientation and can no longer tell sky from ground. PHENIX takes that instant of vertigo, where the boundary between up and down collapses, and treats it as a design brief.Rather than illustrate the idea with graphics alone, the label built it into the garments. The reference line that a silhouette normally hangs from has been pushed out of its expected position, and that shift ripples through length balance, cutting, and the placement of structural seams. Coats stretch long, outerwear volumes swell and drop, and proportions land slightly off from where the eye expects them, so the clothes read with a new focal point instead of a familiar one. The looks pair heavy, protective outer layers with wide, fluid trousers, a tension between mass and drape that keeps the disorientation working across the full outfit.Underpinning the concept is the material engineering PHENIX has spent decades refining on the mountain. The collection uses WINDSTOPPER PRODUCTS by GORE-TEX LABS for its combination of wind resistance and breathability, alongside a proprietary phenix fabric that stays thin while holding up to high water pressure and remaining breathable. Down pieces appear across the range in tones spanning deep blue, burgundy, and forest green as well as black, sitting next to cable knits and tailored topcoats. Executive Creative Director Daisuke Gemma steers the design, folding the weight and comfort of high-performance snow gear into something closer to city minimalism.That mountain-to-street logic is the throughline of PHENIX's own history. The brand launched in Japan in 1952 and moved early on nylon, adopting the then-new material for ski wear by 1955 and helping set the template for the category. In 1978 it developed down capable of withstanding the ultra-high-altitude conditions of the Dhaulagiri expedition at 8,167 meters, a first for the country, and supported the climb to the summit. That track record carried into supplying athletes on Japan's Olympic national team, and as recently as the 2024 Fall/Winter season the label signed on as a supplier to Ski Team Sweden Alpine AB. More than seven decades in, this collection reframes that accumulated technical knowledge as a fashion proposition, one that finds a new landscape for clothing precisely by letting the horizon slip away.The PHENIX Fall/Winter 2026 collection opens for pre-order on August 27 through HBX and the label's online store.

title: ファッションにも注目！プロが推す音楽シーンの次世代アイコン6選
summary: FASHIONSNAPでは、ファッションを中心とした国内の次世代クリエイターを特集中。4本目となる今回は、現代の音楽シーンとそれを取り巻くポップカルチャーを、独自の視点で捉えた文章や音声コンテンツで知られる音楽ライターのつやちゃんに、音楽性だけでなくファッションの個性も光る気鋭のミュージシャンを、ジャンルレスに推薦・寄稿してもらった。 　音楽とファッションは、いつの時代も密接に結びついている。パンクロックにおけるライダース、ヒップホップのバギーなシルエット、グランジのネルシャツ。音楽から生まれたコミュニティにはそれぞれを象徴する装いがあり、ファッションとは、どんな文化に属しているのかを伝える記号でもあった。しかし、今の若いミュージシャンたちを見ると、その関係性は変化している。「このジャンルだから、この服」という定型のスタイルよりも、目を引くのは一人一人のユニークな組み合わせだ。Y2Kやギャル、アウトドア、モード、アニメ、さらに古い時代のスタイルまで、異なる時代や地域の文化を横断し、自分の感覚で選び取っていく感性に満ちている。 　だからこそ、今、ミュージシャンの服を見るのが面白い。どんなアイテムを選び、何と何を結びつけるのか。その選択と組み合わせに、その人自身のアイデンティティや美意識が表れる。ファッションは、ジャンルやシーンへの所属を示すものから、よりパーソナルな美学を映し出すものへと広がっているのだ。本コラムでは、そんな次世代アーティストの中から、特に注目したい6名を紹介しよう。 このコンテンツは FASHIONSNAP が配信しています。

title: 【オフィス訪問レポ】ハースト婦人画報社編　自社スタジオにマッサージルームも
summary: 話題の企業のオフィスを紹介する人気連載企画「オフィス訪問レポ」。約4年ぶりに復活した今回、「エル（ELLE）」や「婦人画報」など運営するハースト婦人画報社およびハースト・デジタル・ジャパン（以下、ハースト）のオフィスを取材しました。広々としたカフェテリアや自社スタジオがあるという、移転して間もない新オフィスの気になる内側は？ 📝読む前に知っておきたい：ハースト婦人画報社およびハースト・デジタル・ジャパンとは？　ハースト婦人画報社は、世界40ヶ国で情報、サービス、メディア事業を展開するアメリカ・ハースト傘下の日本のメディア企業。ハースト・デジタル・ジャパンは、デジタルメディアやWEB事業の強化・拡大を担うために、2016年に株式会社ハースト婦人画報社の100％子会社として設立。1905年に創刊した「婦人画報」をはじめ、「エル」、「ヴァンサンカン（25ans）」、「ハーパーズ バザー（Harper’s BAZAAR）」、「エスクァイア（Esquire）」などを中心に、ファッション、ライフスタイルなどに関する多数のデジタルメディアの運営と雑誌の発行を手掛けている。Eコマース事業にも注力するほか、近年はクライアント企業のマーケティング活動のサポート事業を行うなど、コンテンツ制作における知見にデジタルとデータを融合した企業活動を行う。また、環境マネジメントシステムに関する国際規格「ISO14001」を取得しサステナビリティに配慮した経営を実践している。 このコンテンツは FASHIONSNAP が配信しています。

title: 沖田修一＆姫野花春と本屋さんへ。物語が教えてくれた「表現」の自由と面白さ
summary: 「南極料理人」で話題を集め、「横道世之介」「キツツキと雨」「さかなのこ」などを手掛けてきた映画監督 沖田修一さんの、長編映画デビュー20周年を記念したオリジナル新作映画「さとこはいつも」が9月18日に公開される。同作は、ひょんなきっかけから自分の人生を“物語”として書きはじめる、年齢も育った環境も異なる、同じ「さとこ」という名前の3人の女性たちを描いた物語。同作に登場する「さとこ」の一人で、初恋を持て余し、物語を通して妄想を暴走させていくチャーミングな中学3年生 中井聡子を演じたのは、同作が映像作品デビュー作となった16歳の若手俳優 姫野花春さんだ。 　沖田監督と姫野さんの共通点は、10代から表現活動を始めたことと、本好きであること。お互いのキャリアにとって節目となる作品を共にした2人ならば、本を通してこそ語れることがあるのでは？と、会議室を飛び出して向かったのは小さな古書店。キャリアも世代も異なる2人の、表現における原体験と「物語」から教わったこととは？ 沖田修一 （Syuichi Okita） 映画監督 1977年8月4日生まれ、埼玉県出身。短編映画の自主制作を経て、長編作品『このすばらしきせかい』（06）でデビュー。『南極料理人』(09)が大きな話題となり、2009年度新藤兼人賞金賞を受賞し国内外で高い評価を受ける。『横道世之介』(13)では、第56回ブルーリボン賞最優秀作品賞のほか、第5回TAMA映画賞最優秀作品賞などを受賞。その他の監督作品に、『キツツキと雨』（12）、『モヒカン故郷に帰る』(16)、『モリのいる場所』(18)、『おらおらでひとりいぐも』(20)、『子供はわかってあげない』（21）、『さかなのこ』(22)、ドラマ「0.5の男」(23/WOWOW)、「探偵さん、リュック開いてますよ」(26/EX)などがあり、星野源や乃木坂46のMVも手掛けている。 姫野花春 （Kashun Himeno） 俳優 2010年4月21日生まれ、京都府出身。幼少期より歌やギター、ミュージカルなどに親しみ、表現することに強い関心を抱く。「さとこはいつも」がオーディションを経ての映像作品初出演。好きな本は「海辺のカフカ」（村上春樹）。最近読んで面白かったのは「深夜高速バスに100回ぐらい乗ってわかったこと」（スズキナオ）。 このコンテンツは FASHIONSNAP が配信しています。

title: AHLEM Presents “ECHOES OF LOVE” Eyewear Collection
summary:
Summary

AHLEM unveils its 17-frame "ECHOES OF LOVE" collection inspired by romantic narratives.The range features hand-hammered metals, 22K gold electroplating, nickel-free bronze.Available now via the brand's website and flagship stores.

Los Angeles-based luxury eyewear label AHLEM, founded by Paris-born designer Ahlem Manai-Platt, has unveiled its newest seasonal collection, titled "ECHOES OF LOVE." Comprising 17 distinct metal and acetate frames, the range draws creative inspiration from a cinematic love story set across a single day in a Paris apartment, capturing the emotional nuances between intimacy, tension, and humor.Constructed through rigorous reductionism to highlight proportion and restraint, the line features plant-based cotton flower acetate frames alongside palladium-electroplated metal options finished with 22K gold coating. A key technical highlight includes the introduction of custom nickel-free bronze temples - developed over a year for exceptional skin feel, structural memory, and lightweight durability - paired with hand-hammered textures, step-like temple reliefs and laser-engraved geometric circle and triangle motifs on the hinges and pins.Handcrafted by master artisans in historic eyewear workshops across France, the collection translates architectural references - ranging from Milanese staircases to geometric shadows found in Kyoto - into functional luxury. The acetate range balances deep jewel tones with translucent neutrals that react dynamically to ambient light, while the structural metal pieces combine cool structural stability with warm gold surfaces.AHLEM’s "ECHOES OF LOVE" collection is currently available globally via the brand's physical flagships as well as its official webstore.

title: SAN SAN GEAR Expands Retail Presence With New Flagship Location in Seoul’s Hannam Neighborhood
summary:
Summary

SAN SAN GEAR has officially opened its second flagship store in the quiet, upscale neighborhood of Hannam-dong in Seoul, following its initial flagship in Hapjeong. Designed in collaboration with Tokyo-based studio DAIKEI MILLS, the space embodies the theme of “Duality,” exploring the coexistence of contrasting values such as street style and utility, functionality and design, and private versus public space.Architectural elements blur boundaries between house and courtyard, while layered spatial experiences across multiple floors create a dynamic environment. Highlights include a large circular structure on the first floor, runway-like platforms on the second, and a basement screening room showcasing The Other Lights in the City, a short film tied to the brand’s Fall/Winter 2026 “CABLE” collection.The flagship integrates contributions from international and local designers, with sculptural furniture by Tokyo’s SIIN SIIN and refined pieces by Seoul-based Seong-il Choi, enhancing the immersive brand narrative. Preserving textures of the original residence while introducing public-space motifs, the store reflects SAN SAN GEAR’s expanded worldview and evolving identity. Officially open now, the Hannam flagship establishes a new cultural destination where visitors can engage deeply with the brand’s philosophy and aesthetic.SAN SAN GEAR Hannam Flagship37-10, Itaewon-ro 55-gil, Yongsan-gu,Seoul, South Korea

title: Freddie Mercury's Most Iconic Stage Costumes Are Coming to London's V&A Museum
summary:
Summary

Features eight iconic costumes and personal accessories tracing the legendary frontman's career from Queen's 1973 debut to his later solo workDeveloped in collaboration with Mary Austin to celebrate what would have been Mercury's 80th anniversary yearIncludes a free trail across six locations within the museum's South Kensington galleries featuring sets designed by Tom Piper

The Victoria & Albert Museum is celebrating the enduring cultural legacy of Queen's legendary frontman with Freddie Mercury | Splendid Things. Opening on October 24, 2026, the free trail will map the performer's meteoric rise to global stardom and his subsequent solo career through his highly theatrical wardrobe. The exhibition scatters Mercury's garments across the institution's permanent galleries to explore the meticulous visual language behind one of music history's most recognizable public personas.Developed in collaboration with Mary Austin, Mercury's former fiancée and confidante of two decades, the display borrows seven looks directly from her private collection. The exhibition title itself pulls from the singer's own 1978 declaration: "I like to be surrounded by splendid things. I want to lead a Victorian life surrounded by exquisite clutter." This affinity for curated grandiosity translates directly into the six-stop trail, which creates dialogue between the rocker's stage wear and the museum's existing holdings in fashion, decorative arts and performance.Standout pieces highlight pivotal eras in the band's discography. Visitors can view a 1970s monochrome ensemble worn for an early gig at Imperial College that later graced the cover of Queen's 1973 debut album. The retrospective also features the "Mercury Wing" catsuit designed by Wendy de Smet for the 1975-76 A Night at the Opera tour and the groundbreaking "Bohemian Rhapsody" video. Moving into his stadium era, the display showcases the regal signature crown and cloak crafted by Diana Moseley for his final 1986 Magic Tour appearance at Knebworth alongside quieter personal wardrobe items and his suit from the "Made in Heaven" music video.Award-winning theater and exhibition designer Tom Piper transformed the museum spaces to capture the frontman's magnetic energy. Known for his work with the Royal Shakespeare Company, Piper integrates set dressing, sound and lighting to frame each era. Specially crafted mannequins strike dynamic poses to emulate Mercury's unmatched stage presence, reinforcing how his clothing served as essential tools to command vast arena crowds and cement his status as a permanent pop culture fixture. The installation runs through January 17, 2027.

summary: 日々ファッションを中心にさまざまな領域の新世代を取材するFASHIONSNAPが、次代を担うアップカミングな才能にフォーカスする「次世代クリエイター」特集。設立5年以下で独自の世界観を持つ、注目の若手デザイナー2人目としてフィーチャーするのは、2024年に自身のブランド「カカン（KAKAN）」を立ち上げた工藤花観だ。 　ロンドンのセントラル・セント・マーチンズでファインアートとアクセサリーを専攻し、ミラノでファッションデザインを学んだ彼女が手掛ける服には、相反する要素が美しく共存している。シグネチャーである手紡ぎ糸の「HANDSPAN」シリーズに代表される、有機的で野生的な揺らぎを内包したアートピースのようなニット。その一方で、日常の身体に心地よく寄り添うテーラリングアイテムも支持を集めている。 　「TOKYO FASHION AWARD 2026」の受賞や、東京ファッションウィークでの初ランウェイ、バレエ公演「POLA presents BALLET TheNewClassic 2026」の衣装制作など、デビュー3年目ながら着実に歩みを進めるカカン。9月頭に予定されていた2027年春夏シーズンのランウェイショーは、先日、工藤の体調不良で惜しくも中止と発表されたが、引き続きブランドへの期待は高い。「服は『羊水』のように自分を守ってくれる存在」であると同時に、「自分の生き方をアティチュードとして表現するのに一番使いやすいもの」だと語る工藤は今、自身とブランドの現在地をどう見つめているのか。ロンドンやミラノで得た学びから、人の感覚や感情に寄り添い訴えかけるものづくりの背景、彼女が描くブランドの未来像までを紐解く。 このコンテンツは FASHIONSNAP が配信しています。

title: GEEKS RULE and ‘Ghost in the Shell’ Reunite for a London Pop-Up Built Around Two Silkscreen T-Shirts
summary:
Summary

GEEKS RULE is staging a limited-time Ghost in the Shell pop-up at Dover Street Market LondonThe lineup centers on two silkscreen tees, one tied to the new anime series and one to the 1995 filmPopular archive pieces previously sold in Japan return as part of the collection

GEEKS RULE is bringing its Ghost in the Shell collaboration to Dover Street Market London with a limited-time pop-up that gathers the label's takes on the franchise in one place. Anchored by two silkscreen-printed T-shirts, the shop draws on both the property's newest anime chapter and its most iconic screen moment, giving the collection a foot in each era.The two tees split their references cleanly. One draws on the new Ghost in the Shell anime series and comes in the widest range, offered in White, Black, and Yellow. The other looks back to the 1995 film Ghost in the Shell, arriving in a single Black colorway that leans into the darker, more cinematic side of the source material. Both shirts use silkscreen printing and run from M through XXL, keeping the sizing consistent across the pair.That split is what gives the drop its pull. Ghost in the Shell has spent three decades as a touchstone for cyberpunk aesthetics, its influence stretching across film, animation, and fashion well beyond its original audience. By putting a contemporary anime design next to a tribute to the 1995 feature, GEEKS RULE lets longtime fans and newer viewers meet the franchise wherever they entered it.The pop-up reaches past the two headline tees. Alongside the new pieces, GEEKS RULE is reissuing archive items from its earlier Japan run, a set that built a following the first time around and now gets a second life for the London audience. That mix of fresh designs and returning favorites frames the shop as a fuller survey of the collaboration rather than a single-item release.The GEEKS RULE Ghost in the Shell drops at Dover Street Market London and the online shop on August 28.

title: Kith Unveils Fall 2026 Collection Featuring Needles and NFL Collaborations
summary:
Summary

Kith has officially announced its Fall 2026 collection alongside standalone partnerships with Needles and the NFLThe seasonal release incorporates specialized garment washes elevated leather craftsmanship and lifestyle-focused Kith ClassicsThe collection drops globally on August 28 following an initial Fall Accessories release on August 24

Kith has officially revealed its Fall 2026 Collection, delivering an expansive offering of contemporary apparel, active lifestyle garments, and accessories. The seasonal range is anchored by signature Kith silhouettes alongside two standalone partnerships with Japanese menswear label Needles and the NFL.Outerwear forms the cornerstone of the range, showcasing specialized wash techniques across the Garment Dyed Kip Jacket, Microsuede Puffed Jaysen Hoodie, and Velvet Patina Studded Cassius Jacket. Elevated leather craftsmanship highlights the lineup through the Vintage Leather Alonzo Jacket alongside suede-and-vintage-leather iterations of the Wayne Moto and Rhysand silhouettes. Complementing the outer layers is an assortment of knitwear including the Boucle Heath Sweater Vest, layered shirting, and updated bottom options such as the Cotton Faille Gibbs Pant.The main release is further expanded through two major collaborations. Kith reunites with the NFL for a 30-team sueded velour Leon Shirt capsule commemorating legacy franchises and players with embossed monogram numbering. Additionally, Kith and Needles introduce their debut capsule, combining Japanese craftsmanship and Western Americana across butterfly-embroidered track jackets, fringed trousers, and printed shirting.The Kith Fall 2026 collection releases globally on Friday, August 28, at 11 AM across all Kith flagships, Kith.com, and the Kith App, preceded by the Fall Accessories Monday Program release on August 24.

title: The New Student-Focused NYC by CUNY Collection is Built for the Real Heartbeat of the City
summary:
The City University of New York is quietly staging a cultural takeover beyond the confines of a traditional lecture hall. With a massive footprint of 247,000 students spanning 26 colleges across the five boroughs, CUNY has always been the literal heartbeat of New York City. Now, the university is leaning heavily into that foundational identity with “NYC by CUNY” Spring ’26 collection, an exclusive streetwear range that evolves the campus bookstore merchandise to reflect authentic New York subculture. With this collection, CUNY is embedding itself into the local fashion ecosystem, proving that higher education can actively speak the visual language of the streets it calls home.At its core, this drop is rooted in localized storytelling and everyday New York nostalgia. The standout is a dark graphic tee featuring a meticulously detailed NYC bodega facade, complete with a legendary bodega cat and all 26 college names hidden inside the store signs. For those who grew up on early-2000s East Coast hip-hop, a charcoal metallic tee pays direct homage to the iconic, iridescent rap styling of Queensbridge legend Nas. The rest of the capsule balances this raw energy with premium academic staples, including a heavily washed denim tote bag engineered for students on the move, an NYC souvenir-inspired cream ringer tee, and contrasting crewnecks. There’s one in an ultra-clean forest camo and another in a classic red plaid that bridges the gap between ivy league prestige and concrete streetwear.What makes this project culturally resonant is in the authenticity of its execution. CUNY handed the keys of the entire production over to its own community. The capsule was designed by Baruch College alumni Milton Gordon and Vera Rilossi (who also graduated from BMCC), captured through the lens of Hunter College alum Stanley Ligon, and modeled entirely by actual, current students. Even the editorial lookbook locations were selected with deep cultural intent: the crewnecks were shot amidst the historic architectural woodwork of Baruch’s Oak Room to respect academic tradition, while other pieces were photographed on campus at Lehman College to pay respect to the Bronx—a place that birthed hip-hop music and helped introduced streetwear culture.Ultimately, “NYC by CUNY” matters because it validates the identity of the real New York. It’s a love letter to a student body where half of the undergraduates come from households earning under $30,000 USD a year, and 71% are the first in their families to ever attend college.CUNY represents the ultimate beacon of social mobility, where 82% of freshmen are products of the city’s public school system, and another 82% stick around after graduation to build the future of the five boroughs. By trading stuffy academic pretension for genuine cultural currency, CUNY is executing a beautiful mission of giving hardworking, first-generation New Yorkers the elevated, culturally rich representation they’ve earned.To purchase pieces from the collection visit cuny.edu/collegiate.

title: Stüssy x eYe JUNYA WATANABE MAN Returns for FW26
summary:
SummaryStüssy x eYe JUNYA WATANABE MAN’s Fall collection offers Prep-inspired classics with subtle streetwear twists and discreet front branding.Dropping August 28, the capsule includes Oxford shirts, outerwear, and cargo pants featuring iconic Stüssy graphics on the back.Stüssy x eYe JUNYA WATANABE MAN have revealed an official look at their latest tie-up, and it’s dialing in on Fall closet staples. From long-sleeve button-ups in 3 colors to jacket silhouettes for every occasion, and a hefty pair of ripstop cargoes, the collaborators have unveiled a range of Prep-inspired classics with subtle streetwear twists. While logos are kept rather discreet on the front sides of the garments, the back designs are what stand out. A seemingly typical Ivy League-inspired blazer has a St. Malmo crest on the breast, but on the back it boasts a faded Stüssy Venus graphic. Elsewhere, a classic varsity-style jacket is logoless on the front, while the back shows the Stüssy logo above a dragon embroidery. However, other outerwear pieces are more subtle, including the belted leather jacket, which features no external branding, and the black utility jacket with a small logo in the classic breast placement. For tops, the Oxford-style shirting quietly hosts tonal Stüssy emblems on the chest that blend into the colorway, including a surfer, a crown, the double S insignia, a skull, an 8-ball, and a pair of dice.Lastly, the release is topped off by a pair of olive ripstop cargo pants with orange branding on the back pocket. However, the JUNYA WATANABE MAN FW26 runway show initially showcased additional pieces, including tan khakis covered in Stüssy branding, so more product from the collaborators may be on the way soon.The FW26 Stüssy x eYe JUNYA WATANABE MAN collection will drop on August 28 at Stüssy stores and Dover Street Market Ginza.

title: Gucci's Primavera Campaign Is a Fusion of K-Pop, UK Underground, DMV Rap & More
summary:
SummaryThe Gucci FW26 Primavera campaign stars Jin, Shawn Mendes, EsDeeKid, NINGNING, Rico Nasty, Tom Brady, Xiao Zhan, Lee Young Ae, and Alex Consani.Shot by Michal Chelbin, it highlights everyday glamour featuring leather and fur-forward menswear and womenswear.In Milan last Spring, Demna's FW26 runway debut set a new tone for Gucci, rooted in pop culture and an equal embrace of the high and low. The Creative Director's democratic ethos continues yet again in the star-studded Gucci Primavera campaign, which traverses the realms of cinema, global pop, emerging acts, and sports culture.Photographed by Michal Chelbin, the campaign's setting departs from the clean backdrops of Demna's typical style for a rustic Italian interior true to Gucci's Florentine heritage. The cast enlists 10 major international figures, each with varying degrees of fame. Notably in music, BTS's Jin, American singer Shawn Mendes, UK underground star EsDeeKid, Chinese singer NINGNING, and DMV rapper Rico Nasty showcase the diverse musical taste profile Demna has shown throughout his career. In a nod to American football, legendary athlete Tom Brady makes an unexpected appearance, while Chinese actor Xiao Zhan and South Korean actress Lee Young Ae represent Asian cinema.In this campaign, the FW26 collection is seen in a new, softer light, offering a better impression of its everyday, albeit glamorous sensibility. In menswear, leather and lustrous fabrics reign supreme. Standout pieces include the leather motorsport jacket worn by Jin, Shawn Mendes's shiny muscle t-shirt, and the golden trousers worn by Xiao Zhan. Womenswear leans more heavily into furs, as seen in a cream fur coat styled on Rico Nasty with a leather handbag, and on a fur shoulder wrap worn by Lee Young Ae. American model and internet personality Alex Consani's look reads as the centerpiece of the campaign, featuring an asymmetrical, purple sequined dress with a pearl-studded clutch.See the full campaign in the gallery above and stay tuned to Hypebeast for the latest fashion industry news and insights.

title: Madhappy and PUMA Reconnect for a Third Collaborative Release
summary:
Summary

PUMA and Madhappy drop their third capsule, focusing on "inactive activewear" and post-workout wellness.Sneaker highlights include the PUMA H-Street, special-edition Suede and a Madhappy-exclusive Speedcat Plus.Releasing on August 28 via Madhappy, followed by a global PUMA launch on September 5.

Drawing visual cues from California's coastal landscapes, sandy beaches and Malibu sunsets, the lineup emphasizes recovery, wellness and post-workout comfort.The collaboration spotlights two sneaker silhouettes at its core, including the H-Street, a special-edition Suede, and a Madhappy-exclusive Speedcat Plus. Each pair is rendered in an earthy, muted color palette and updated with Madhappy's signature hand-crafted stitch detailing alongside understated co-branding hits.The apparel range extends the laid-back aesthetic with a cropped knitted T7 jacket and flared pants, reworking PUMA’s classic tracksuit through Madhappy’s relaxed lens. The exclusive Speedcat Plus will be available from August 28, 2026 via Madhappy, while the full collection launches on September 5, 2026 through PUMA.

title: Stockholm Surfboard Club and RHC Turn the Icon Tag Navy for the "Black Beach" Capsule
summary:
Summary

Stockholm Surfboard Club and RHC assemble a special-order "Black Beach" capsule described as one of SSC's largest-ever rangesThree of the brand's signature logos are applied selectively across a hooded shirt, polo shirt, back logo tee, and capSSC's signature red icon tag is reworked in navy for the first time as a world-first special-order label

Stockholm Surfboard Club and RHC have teamed on "Black Beach," a special-order capsule that pairs the Swedish label's surf sensibility with Ron Herman's clean house style. Built out as one of SSC's largest assortments to date, the collection spans four core pieces and centers on a detail the brand has never altered before: its signature icon tag, here rendered in navy.The logos do the design work. The capsule is built around three of the signature logos SSC has carried and preserved over the years, applied piece by piece so that each garment gets the mark best suited to its character rather than a single logo stamped across the range. That approach runs through all four styles, from the cap and back logo tee to the polo shirt and hooded shirt, the latter two representing the kind of pieces that have become popular signatures of SSC in recent seasons.The headline detail is smaller but more significant. For "Black Beach," SSC took its emblematic red-based icon tag and switched it to a navy base, creating what the collection frames as a world-first special-order label for the brand. It is a subtle change on paper, but for a label whose red tag functions as a recognition point, reworking it in navy turns an ordinary branding element into the capsule's defining flourish, finished with close attention to detail.The lineup itself is compact but considered. It runs across a black Hooded Shirt, a black Polo Shirt, a white Back Logo Tee, and a black Logo Cap, a mostly blacked-out spread that reads directly off the "Black Beach" name. Taken together, the release positions itself as a meeting of Stockholm's quiet surf culture and RHC's understated sensibility, framed as a one-season-only capsule rather than a permanent addition.The Stockholm Surfboard Club x RHC "Black Beach" collection arrives at the online store on August 29 and is already available at RHC Ron Herman and Ron Herman "R" stores.

title: 「無知って強い」　20代で店を始めた3人が語る、令和のセレクトショップ事情
summary: 次のファッションシーンを作るのは、デザイナーだけではない。どんな服を選び、どう見せるか。独自の感性で新たなスタイルを提案するショップもまた、新しい才能や価値観が広がっていくきっかけを作る存在だ。 　そこでFASHIONSNAPの「次世代クリエイター」特集の2本目では、20代でそれぞれショップを立ち上げた「スタジオラボ404ドットコム（studiolab404.com）」（以下、スタジオラボ）のモネと、「ディソナンス（DISSONANCE）」の森下リョウジ、モハメド・アズハリ・アフメド（Mohamed Azhari Ahmed）の鼎談を実施。スタジオラボは、デッドストックと国内外のデザイナーズブランド、オリジナルアイテムを独自の視点で提案。一方のディソナンスは、国内外のデザイナーズブランドのアーカイヴを軸に、オリジナルレーベルの販売やヴィジュアル制作、「エイチ ビューティー＆ユース（H BEAUTY&YOUTH）」の古着コーナー「H_VINTAGE」のキュレーションなどを手掛けている。異なるアプローチで店を作る彼らは、今のファッションをどう見て、何を面白いと感じているのか。20代で店を始めた理由から、セレクトの基準、同世代への意識、そしてこれから作りたい景色まで、同世代だからこその率直な会話を記録した。 モネ （MONET） 「スタジオラボ404ドットコム」オーナー兼ディレクター 1994年、兵庫県生まれ。ニューヨークでSNS運用やマーケティング、ショールーム業務などを経験後、 2021年に東京・祐天寺でセレクトショップ「スタジオラボ404ドットコム」を創業。デッドストックアイテムや国内未上陸ブランド、ジュエリーなどを扱いながら、コミュニティとしての店づくりにも取り組む。2026年4月に大阪・心斎橋パルコに新店舗をオープンした 。 森下凌司 DISSONANCEオーナー、スタイリスト 1996年、広島県生まれ。学生時代に古着屋で2年間勤務。大学卒業後はアパレル企業に入社し、販売員を2年間経験した後、2022年に「ディソナンス」をオープン。現在はバイイングやショップ運営のほか、ファッションスタイリストとしても活動中。 モハメド・アズハリ・アフメド DISSONANCEオーナー 1998年、東京都生まれ。モデル、フォトグラファー、WEBディレクターとしてファッション業界を中心に活動する一方、中目黒のヴィンテージショップ「ディソナンス」も運営。 ◾️studiolab404.com2021年に東京・祐天寺にオープン。上海発「ルオハン（RUOHAN）」や米国発「ノン ラック（NONG RAK）」などのデザイナーズブランドやヴィンテージ、オリジナルプロダクトを独自の視点で提案している。2026年4月に心斎橋パルコに2号店を出店した。【祐天寺店】住所：東京都目黒区祐天寺1-31-12営業時間：13:00〜20:00定休日：水・木曜【心斎橋店】住所：大阪府大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-8-3 心斎橋パルコ 地下1階営業時間：10:00〜20:00公式サイトInstagram ◾️DISSONANCE2022年に東京・渋谷に予約制ショップとしてオープン。2024年10月に中目黒へ移転し、予約不要の通常営業を開始した。ヴィンテージやデザイナーズのアーカイヴ、オリジナルブランド「ニュートラル（Ntrul）」などを販売するほか、衣装のリース業務も行う。2026年4月からは「エイチ ビューティー＆ユース（H BEAUTY&YOUTH）」の古着コーナー「H_VINTAGE」のキュレーションを担当している。住所：東京都目黒区上目黒1-15-1営業時間：14:00〜20:00公式サイトInstagram このコンテンツは FASHIONSNAP が配信しています。

title: Louis Vuitton Steers Its Trunk-Making Heritage Under the Sea With the High Trunks
summary:
Summary

Louis Vuitton frames its new High Trunks as an oceanic evolution of the Courrier Lozine 110Pharrell Williams anchors the project in the House's trunk-making history and the flexibility written into the 1905 Monogram patentTechniques ranging from hand-cut leather to inlaid mother of pearl and mirrored chrome push the Monogram into new material territory

Louis Vuitton has unveiled the High Trunks, a set of oceanic reinterpretations of the Courrier Lozine 110 introduced by Men's Creative Director Pharrell Williams for the House's Men's Spring-Summer 2027 collection. Rather than treat the trunk as a fixed object, the project uses it as a testing ground for craft, translating the marine theme at the center of the season into surfaces built from leather, shell, and chrome.The heritage argument sits right in the release. Louis Vuitton points to its 1905 Monogram patent, which explicitly allowed for variations in color, size, and material, and positions that document as the license for everything the High Trunks attempt. It is a neat way of framing radical material experiments as an extension of the House's own rulebook rather than a break from it, tying Pharrell's oceanic vision back to a founding principle instead of layering it on top. Louis Vuitton has long invited outside artists and designers into its world, and Pharrell's tenure as Men's Creative Director continues that pattern of handing the Monogram to a new author.Each trunk carries the theme through a different discipline. The unique Leather Marquetry "Under the Sea" Courrier Lozine 110 renders coral reefs, tropical fish, and aquatic flora from more than 1,500 individually cut leather elements, drawing on over 35 leathers chosen for grain, color, and texture, with shell-shaped metallic corners carrying the marine motif past the marquetry itself. The Mother of Pearl Marquetry version, made alongside a French marquetry artisan, inlays more than 2,000 hand-cut pieces of sustainably sourced mother of pearl into smoked larch wood, letting the Monogram catch and shift the light. The Chrome Wave takes the opposite route, sculpting transparent acrylic into wave forms, laser-engraving the Monogram, then finishing the panels in motion with two silver chrome coatings for a mirrored surface hiding neon Monogram flowers, its contemporary shell opening onto a traditional cream VVN leather interior.The collection stretches well beyond those three. Liquid Python wraps both the Courrier Lozine 110 and the Coffret 8 Montres in hand-finished python leather with a water-like effect, while the Summer Captions Courrier Lozine 110 catches a seaside-sunset glow through translucent acrylic. New silhouettes such as the LV Turtle Trunk and Neo Briefcase Trunk revisit the House's travel vocabulary in contemporary proportions, and the Mini Malle Bijoux arrives as an object built for the rituals of modern travel and collecting. Read as a group, the High Trunks make the case that the Monogram is less a print than a platform, one durable enough to survive being cut into leather, embedded in shell, and poured into chrome without losing its identity.First revealed at the Men's Spring-Summer 2027 show, the High Trunks are available in select Louis Vuitton stores worldwide and through the House's Savoir Rêver events. The Mother of Pearl Marquetry, Chrome Wave, Summer Captions, and Liquid Python Courrier Lozine 110 can be ordered with a ten-month lead time, with further pieces from the collection arriving from January 2027.

title: SOPHNET. and L.L.Bean Build the Boat and Tote on 24 oz Heavy Canvas With Scorpion Embroidery
summary:
Summary

SOPHNET. and L.L.Bean base their collaborative tote on L.L.Bean's Boat and Tote using durable 24 oz heavy canvas cottonA SOPHNET. brand-name patch and a scorpion embroidery sit on the black or natural bodyThe bag comes in Large, Medium, and Mini sizes to suit different uses and styling

SOPHNET. and L.L.Bean have reworked the Boat and Tote, building their collaborative version on L.L.Bean's signature carrier and its heavy-duty canvas. The project keeps the tote's functional foundation intact while layering in SOPHNET.'s own graphic detailing, resulting in a bag defined as much by its material as by its branding.The base does the structural work. The tote is made from L.L.Bean's 24 oz heavy canvas cotton, a weight chosen for high durability, and that dense cotton gives the bag its rigidity and hard-wearing character before any graphics enter the picture. It is the same construction logic that underpins the original Boat and Tote, carried over here without dilution.SOPHNET.'s contribution is concentrated in the surface detailing. The black or natural body is fitted with a SOPHNET. brand-name patch alongside a scorpion embroidery, the two elements combining the label's graphic identity with the tote's plain canvas ground. Around the trim, an L.L.Bean tag remains in place, keeping both names present on the finished piece and marking the split of responsibilities between the two.The range is built for flexibility. The tote is offered in three sizes, Large, Medium, and Mini, a spread designed to cover different uses and styling preferences rather than a single fixed format. Together with the choice of black or natural, that three-size structure gives the collaboration a small matrix of configurations built on one durable canvas template.The SOPHNET. x L.L.Bean Boat and Tote releases August 28 via SOPH. SHOP, SOPH. DEALER, and the online store.

title: Shein Prepares for IPO at $27 Billion USD Valuation
summary:
Summary

Shein has officially launched its global offering seeking to raise up to $1.77 billion USD on the Hong Kong Stock ExchangeThe ultra-fast-fashion company is targeting a valuation of roughly $27 billion USD ahead of its planned September 1 trading debutThe public offering comes as the company navigates slowing growth shifting global trade policies and increased fulfillment expenses

Shein has officially launched its global offering, setting the stage for an initial public offering on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange targeting a valuation of roughly $27 billion USD. The ultra-fast-fashion retailer is offering 280 million shares priced between $47.60 HKD and $49.50 HKD to raise up to $13.86 billion HKD (approximately $1.77 billion USD).The company's planned debut follows its listing hearing clearance in July, with financial backing co-sponsored by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and JPMorgan. Cornerstone investors behind the offering include Boyu Capital, Tiger Global, General Atlantic, Tencent, Greenwoods Asset Management, and Taikang Life Insurance. The resulting $27 billion USD valuation sits below its pandemic-era peak, placing Shein at roughly 0.7 times forecast sales.The public listing arrives during a challenging fiscal period for the retailer, marked by trade policy shifts such as the removal of de minimis exemptions in the U.S. and European Union. Shein reported a 38.7% drop in net profit to $2.06 billion USD for 2025, followed by a first-quarter 2026 net loss of $99 million USD. To preserve voting power for founder Chris Xu (Xu Yangtian), who holds a 33% stake, the company plans to adopt a dual-class share structure upon going public.The final offer price for Shein's global offering will be set on August 31, 2026, with official trading scheduled to commence on September 1, 2026.

title: WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto x NEEDLES Stitch a Rose and a Butterfly Into a Satin Cowboy One-Up Shirt
summary:
Summary

WILDSIDE and NEEDLES build the S/S Cowboy One-up Shirt on a NEEDLES body carrying both labels' signature embroideryTwo NEEDLES butterflies and a WILDSIDE rose are positioned to symbolize the collaboration itselfA smooth satin fabric, boxy Western silhouette, and black snap buttons round out the design

WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto and NEEDLES have joined forces on the S/S Cowboy One-up Shirt, a Western-leaning piece that lets each label speak through its own signature embroidery. Constructed on a NEEDLES body, the shirt pairs the brand's butterfly motif with WILDSIDE's rose, framing the collaboration as a literal meeting of two emblems on a single garment.The embroidery does the heavy lifting. Two NEEDLES butterflies land across the chest and back alongside WILDSIDE's rose, and the placement of those butterflies is deliberate, arranged to stand in for the partnership rather than sit as decoration. The detail that seals it is on the reverse: the back rose is stitched in a purple made exclusively for this release, a small flourish that keeps the piece from reading as a straight logo swap between two houses. The butterfly has long been a NEEDLES calling card and the rose a WILDSIDE fixture, so seeing them share one panel is the entire point.Underneath the graphics, the make is where the shirt earns its price of entry. It is cut from a smooth satin with a refined sheen and soft hand, a blend of triacetate, cupra, and polyester that gives the Western shape a dressier finish than the cowboy reference might suggest. The silhouette stays boxy with a moderate length and subtle stripes running through the fabric, while black snap buttons add a sharp, low-key accent against the sheen. It is finished in Japan, and the rayon embroidery threads keep the surface work crisp against the satin ground.Framed together, the two elements tell the collaboration's story cleanly. The Western template and satin build give the shirt its body, and the paired embroidery gives it its reason to exist, a compact example of two Japanese labels trading motifs instead of simply co-signing a blank. That the collaboration is capped at one per customer only underlines how it is being positioned, as a limited handshake between WILDSIDE and NEEDLES rather than a broad rollout.The WILDSIDE x NEEDLES S/S Cowboy One-up Shirt releases August 26 via WILDSIDE YOHJI YAMAMOTO.

title: A24 Launches Pop-Up Store at Isetan Shinjuku Featuring 'Backrooms' and 'The Drama' Merchandise
summary:
Summary

A24 has opened a limited-time pop-up store at Isetan Shinjuku in Tokyo running through September 3 2026The event features collaborative silkscreen T-shirts with GEEKS RULE inspired by 'Backrooms' alongside logo apparel for 'The Drama'Additional items available include film soundtrack vinyl records and official studio merchandise

A24 and GEEKS RULE have officially launched an exclusive pop-up store at Isetan Shinjuku celebrating the releases of its films Backrooms and The Drama. Located on the second floor of the main building inside TOKYO Closet, the temporary installation showcases a specialized range of movie merchandise, graphic tees, and physical music releases.Leading the apparel selection is a trio of graphic T-shirts created in collaboration with Japanese fashion brand GEEKS RULE for Backrooms. Utilizing silkscreen printing techniques engineered to replicate the look and feel of vintage 1990s movie apparel, the designs incorporate the film's iconic "Yellow Labyrinth" imagery alongside graphics that reflect its unsettling atmosphere. The Backrooms x GEEKS RULE tees span three distinct volumes priced at ¥11,000 JPY and ¥13,200 JPY.For The Drama, the pop-up offers official logo T-shirts priced at ¥7,700 JPY. The pieces feature the film's title alongside classic A24 branding across black, white, and burgundy colorways. Beyond apparel, visitors can purchase soundtrack vinyl records and official film goods on-site.The A24 pop-up store is open daily from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. through September 3, 2026, at Isetan Shinjuku Main Building 2F TOKYO Closet.

title: NEEDLES and Brooks Brothers Merge Heritage Tailoring With Modern Streetwear
summary:
Summary

NEEDLES and Brooks Brothers have officially announced a collaborative capsule collection merging American menswear with Japanese designThe offering features tailored sport coats matching trousers check button-downs v-neck and mock neck sweaters silk ties and leather loafersThe collection drops via a two-stage release beginning September 2 followed by a wider rollout on September 9

NEEDLES and Brooks Brothers have officially unveiled a collaborative capsule collection merging classic American tailoring with Japanese design perspectives. Created in partnership with NEPENTHES founder Keizo Shimizu, the upcoming release reimagines traditional menswear through modern, relaxed silhouettes.The extensive collection features tailored outerwear, knitwear, accessories, and footwear. Highlight pieces include Sport Coats (¥107,800 JPY) and matching Trousers (¥52,800 JPY) in Black and Bordeaux, alongside check Button-down Shirts (¥34,100 JPY) in Green and Red. The knitwear assortment introduces V-neck Sweaters (¥49,500 JPY) in Black/Purple and Brown/Orange, paired with Mock Neck Sweaters (¥39,600 JPY) offered in Black and Purple.Completing the range are silk Ties (¥22,000 JPY) and leather Loafers (¥154,000 JPY) available in Black and Burgundy finishes.The NEEDLES x Brooks Brothers collection pre-sale begins September 2, 2026, via Brooks Brothers Shinjuku Isetan, Umeda Hankyu, Nepenthes locations, and their respective webstores, followed by a wider release on September 9, 2026, across select Brooks Brothers retail doors in Japan.

title: 「日本の美意識は私たちのデザインに近い」アイビー・ロスが語るGoogle Store 表参道
summary: 2026年8月、東京・明治神宮前交差点に面した東急プラザ表参道「オモカド」に、グーグルの直営店「Google Store 表参道」がオープンした。 　2021年にニューヨークのチェルシー地区で最初のGoogle Storeがオープンしてから米国で10店舗を開いたが、米国外はこの店が初めて。同時に、これまでで最大規模の店舗で、地下1階、1階、2階の3フロア構成。同社の日本市場への意気込みは、この店だけに用意されたアート作品や日本限定グッズからも伝わってくる。 　ストアでは、PixelスマートフォンやPixel Watchをはじめとする最新のGoogle製品、同店限定品を含むオリジナルグッズを販売。AIで自分のアバターを生成できるプリクラのような体験をはじめ、グーグルの最新技術を試せるコーナーを2階に設けるほか、地下1階では修理や専門スタッフへの相談にも対応する。店内の各所には、Google製品の世界観や製造背景を紹介する展示がちりばめられている。 　店のデザインを手掛けたのは、グーグルのチーフ・デザイン・オフィサー、アイビー・ロス（Ivy Ross）。「カルバン・クライン（Calvin Klein）」「コーチ（COACH）」「スウォッチ（Swatch）」「ギャップ（Gap）」のほか、マテル（Mattel）社などで製品デザインやブランド、マーケティングの要職を歴任し、2014年、スマートグラス「Google Glass」の責任者としてグーグルに入社した。2016年に発足したハードウェアデザインチームのトップに就任し、「ハードウェアを機械ではなく、日々身につけ、触れ、感情を重ねるものとして考える」という姿勢のもと、柔らかなフォルムや温かみのある色使い、一目でGoogle製品と分かる個性を備えたPixelシリーズなどの世界観をつくってきた人物だ。 　大盛況だったオープン翌日の早朝、帰国を前にしたロスが、空港へ向かうまでの短い時間、インタビューに応じてくれた。 このコンテンツは FASHIONSNAP が配信しています。

title: FC Barcelona Debuts Kobe Bryant-Inspired "Barça Mamba" Away Kit
summary:
Summary

FC Barcelona has officially debuted its new Barça Mamba away kit on the pitch against Elche CFThe jersey features a striking purple and yellow colorway inspired by Kobe Bryant and his Mamba MentalityThe match debut coincided directly with Kobe Bryant's birthday

FC Barcelona has officially debuted its new "Barça Mamba" away kit on the pitch during a match against Elche CF. Taking the field on Kobe Bryant’s birthday, the Spanish club honored the legendary athlete by bringing his iconic spirit directly to football.The kit showcases a striking purple and yellow design, drawing direct visual inspiration from Kobe Bryant’s court-side legacy. Built around the ethos of Bryant’s signature "Mamba Mentality," the jersey translates court-side focus and relentless drive straight onto the pitch. The jerseys feature a black to purple gradient from the shoulders to the bottom of the shirt, while the shorts come in all-purple but with a subtle snakeskin texture pattern as a nod to the Black Mamba. The socks, shorts and jersey all feature the signature sheath logo which received an iridescent transformation. The team's track jacket also received a "Barça Mamba" makeover, arriving in black and purple snakeskin texture to match the aesthetic. On the other hand, the goalie jersey is entirely in a golden yellow snakeskin pattern, keeping in line with the purple and gold team Bryant spent his entire career.The FC Barcelona "Barça Mamba" away kit made its official on-pitch debut against Elche CF and are now available online at FC Barça's site.
